_comment: The four listings that joined Yoga & Pilates when the yoga specialty was
merged into it, checked for `beginners` on 20 August 2026.
They were never checked because they were not in the category when the
first pass ran. Coverage fell from 9/9 to 9/13 the moment they arrived,
which is the gate behaving correctly: a set is only as checked as its
Unearth Remedy matched a third time inside a customer testimonial. Not
used — a customer saying a session suited them is not the practice
saying who its sessions are for.
